description_en: Queries all works in a workspace under an organization. You can specify the type of work
description_zh: 查询组织下某个工作空间下的所有作品，可指定作品类型
name: QueryWorksByWorkspace

parameters.help_en:
The type of the work. Valid values:

*   DATAPRODUCT: BI portal
*   PAGE: Dashboard
*   FULLPAGE: full-screen dashboards
*   REPORT: workbook
parameters.help_zh:
作品类型。取值范围：

- DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
- PAGE：仪表板
- FULLPAGE：全屏仪表板
- REPORT：电子表格
parameters.name: works_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the work. Valid values:

*   0: unpublished
*   1: published
*   2: modified but not published
*   3: unpublished
parameters.help_zh:
作品状态。取值范围：

- 0：未发布
- 1：已发布
- 2：已修改未发布
- 3：已下线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Third-party embedding status. Valid values:

*   0: The embed service is not enabled.
*   1: Embed is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
第三方嵌入状态。取值范围：

- 0：暂未开通嵌入
- 1：已开通嵌入
parameters.name: third_part_auth_flag

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the returned page.

*   Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries returned per page.

*   Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size
